+

+    with store.ManagedSessionMaker() as s:
+        s.add(SqlIssue(issue_id=iid, experiment_id=int(exp_id), name=iid, description="d",
+                       status="pending", severity=sev, created_timestamp=1, last_updated_timestamp=1))
+
+def add_trace_link(iid, trace_id):
+    with store.ManagedSessionMaker() as s:
+        # need a trace_info row (FK)
+        s.add(SqlTraceInfo(request_id=trace_id, experiment_id=str(exp_id), timestamp_ms=1,
+                           execution_time_ms=1, status="OK"))
+        s.flush()
+        s.add(SqlAssessments(assessment_id="a-"+uuid.uuid4().hex[:8], trace_id=trace_id, name=iid,
+                             assessment_type="issue", value="{}", created_timestamp=1,
+                             last_updated_timestamp=1, source_type="CODE", valid=True))
+
+add_issue("iss-high", "high")
+add_issue("iss-med1", "medium")
+add_issue("iss-med2", "medium")
+add_issue("iss-none", "low")
+
+# high: 1 trace, med1: 3 traces, med2: 5 traces, none: 0
+add_trace_link("iss-high", "t1")
